claims.statement: Tom Allen, the ex-pugilist, kept a saloon on Market Street between Sixth and Seventh streets.
claims.excerpt: who keeps a saloon on Market street, between Sixth and Seventh streets
places: Market Street, between Sixth and Seventh streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: At about 1 a.m. Tom Allen fired three shots into the air from the sidewalk outside his saloon to get rid of two quarrelsome men, and no policeman was near.
claims.excerpt: he went on the sidewalk and fired three shots into the air
places: Market Street, between Sixth and Seventh streets, St. Louis

notes: Date is the morning of the paper's date ('this morning'). The two men are not named.
